title: 第13章 柳千阳第14章 火绫山
slug: 万古第一神第7596章第三轮
content_zh:
柳卿的话，不只是李天命想不通，在场大多数人都是一脸疑惑。
甚至包括莫夫人和李紫峰，连他们母子都不知道，还会有其他人参加炎黄学宫决选！
离火城范围之内有多少竞争者，他们都非常清楚。
每个人的底细，从祖上多少代都能翻出来。
李炎枫看着李天命的目光又冷淡了很多。
但是，当他回头的时候，脸上自然的浮现出了一种长辈对晚辈的笑容，眼神里透露出的是欣赏和爱护。
“千阳，你虽然远道而来，但我和你姐姐成婚之后，你便算是我离火城之人了。”
他的目光锁定在坐席之中一位大约十五六岁的少年身上，这个少年一时间成为了全场焦点。
“我们离火城的年轻人，多数都是井底之蛙，不知道真正的天才有何等造化，你虽然年纪小，但是辈分比较高，便下去展示一下，让井底之蛙见识见识。”
李炎枫面带微笑道。
“千阳，还不快去。”
柳卿挽着李炎枫的胳膊催促道。
人们终于听明白了！
这个叫做柳千阳的少年，是柳卿的弟弟，自然也来自雷尊府！
“夫人的弟弟，也可以算离火城的吧，城主的意思是，让夫人的弟弟来竞争炎黄令？这是临时起意，还是早就安排好了……”
很多人细思极恐，因为这样的安排明显不太像临时起意。
这很可能说明，李炎枫今天根本就没准备把炎黄令给二儿子李紫峰，怪不得他先立世子却没有下文。
两个儿子在竞争，炎黄令却准备好了给新夫人的弟弟？
这样的真相，大多数人不敢说，也不敢问，所以这时候全场悄然死寂，所有人都在注视着那个来自雷尊府的少年，在听风楼上站起来。
当这少年出现在人们的视野之中的时候，光是第一眼，在场众人都能看出来，和离火城的天才们对比，这少年才算是真正的人中龙凤！

他年纪看起来比李紫峰还小，肤色非常白，长相和柳卿相似，自然英俊明朗，尤其是一双眼睛晶莹闪光，如同宝石。
不过最引人瞩目的还是他的气质，那是与生俱来的贵族气质，只有雷尊府这样的一方巨擘，方能培养出这样的天才！
和他一比较，骄纵聒噪的李紫峰马上就落入了下乘，这个叫做柳千阳的少年，直接展现了什么叫做大世家子弟的贵气，那是一种高不可攀的感觉。
人们看着这少年走出来，眼里都满是赞叹之意，这样的人物，确实足以让人们忘记离火城的年轻人们。
“千阳，想要炎黄令的话，靠你自己去争取呢。”
柳卿给他整理了一下衣物温柔说道。
“好的，姐姐。
谢谢姐夫。”
少年谈吐得体，看起来非常乖巧且有礼貌，可这样就认定对方软弱就大错特错了。
柳千阳的出现意味着什么，在场众人都明白。
姜还是老的辣，李天命自认为打败李紫峰，就能拿到炎黄令，就能在李炎枫这里讨回尊严，但他明白没预料到柳千阳的存在，更没猜测今日李炎枫到底想把炎黄令给谁！
人们看着李炎枫看着柳千阳那种欣赏爱护的眼神就知道，他早就做出了这个决定，他似乎对两个儿子，都未曾这么欣赏过。
说实话，李天命觉得自己还是低估了李炎枫的不要脸了。
这个人啊，真是绝了。
更关键是，他看着柳千阳这英俊的像是个女孩的脸蛋，似乎有一种似曾相似的感觉。
三年前，雷尊府的妖孽‘林潇霆’有很多跟班，十一二岁的都有，虽然眼前的人长大了，但李天命大概能想起他三年前的样子。
没错，李天命三年前，就见过柳千阳！
“李天命，三年前，潇霆哥哥处死你伴生兽的时候，我在现场看到了。”
柳千阳得到允许之后，在万众瞩目之下跳下听风楼，那晶莹剔透的眼睛直接锁定了李天命。
果然是他！

在那个绝望的时刻，李天命记住了所有雷尊府的人，记住了所有的仇家，包括这个孩子。
当然，今天他已经不是孩子了。
“炎黄令眼看就是你的了，但是可惜了，因为要在焱都那种竞争环境拿到炎黄令太难了，所以我取巧了，以离火城的身份进炎黄学宫。”
柳千阳落在了听风台上，说出了他今日出现在这里的缘由。
content_en:
Not only was Li Tianming confused by Liu Qing's words, but most of the people present looked confused.
Including Mrs. Mo and Li Zifeng, not even their mother and son knew that there would be other people participating in the final election of Yanhuang Academy!
They all know very well how many competitors there are within the range of Fire City.
The details of each person can be found out from many generations of ancestors.
Li Yanfeng looked at Li Tianming with much colder eyes.
However, when he looked back, a kind of smile from an elder to a younger person naturally appeared on his face, and his eyes showed appreciation and love.
"Qianyang, although you have come from afar, after I get married to your sister, you will be my friend from Fire City."
His eyes were fixed on a young man of about fifteen or sixteen years old who was sitting in the seats. This young man became the focus of the audience for a while.
"Most of our young people in Lihuo City are frogs in the well. They don't know how talented a real genius is. Although you are young, you are senior, so go down and show it to the frogs in the well."
Li Yanfeng said with a smile.
"Qianyang, hurry up and go."
Liu Qing took Li Yanfeng's arm and urged.
People finally understand!
This young man named Liu Qianyang is Liu Qing’s younger brother, and he naturally comes from Lei Zun Mansion!
"Madam's younger brother can also be considered from Lihuo City. What the city lord wants is for Madam's younger brother to compete for the Yanhuang Order? Is this a spur-of-the-moment idea, or has it been arranged long ago..."
Many people think about it with great fear, because such an arrangement obviously does not look like a last-minute idea.
This probably means that Li Yanfeng has no plans to give the Yanhuang Order to his second son Li Zifeng today. No wonder he established the heir first but did not follow up.
The two sons are competing, but Yanhuang Ling is ready to give his new wife's brother?
Most people didn't dare to tell or ask such a truth, so at this time the whole place was silent. Everyone was watching the young man from Lei Zun Mansion standing up on Tingfeng Tower.
When this young man appeared in people's sight, at the first glance, everyone present could tell that compared with the geniuses of Lihuo City, this young man was truly the best among people!
He looks younger than Li Zifeng, has a very white complexion, and looks similar to Liu Qing. He is naturally handsome and bright, especially his eyes that are as sparkling as gems.
But the most eye-catching thing is his temperament, which is an innate aristocratic temperament. Only a giant like Lei Zunfu can cultivate such a genius!
Compared with him, the arrogant and noisy Li Zifeng immediately fell into the inferior category. This young man named Liu Qianyang directly demonstrated what it means to be a noble person from a big family. It felt unattainable.
People looked at this young man walking out with admiration in their eyes. Such a character is indeed enough to make people forget about the young people in Lihuo City.
"Qianyang, if you want the Yanhuang Order, you have to fight for it yourself."
Liu Qing tidied his clothes and said softly.
"Okay, sister.
Thank you brother-in-law. "
The young man spoke well and seemed very well-behaved and polite, but it would be a big mistake to assume that the other person was weak.
Everyone present understood what Liu Qianyang's appearance meant.
Jiang is still old and spicy. Li Tianming thought that by defeating Li Zifeng, he could get the Yanhuang Order and regain his dignity from Li Yanfeng. However, he knew that he had not expected Liu Qianyang's existence, and he had not guessed who Li Yanfeng wanted to give the Yanhuang Order to today!
When people looked at Li Yanfeng and Liu Qianyang's admiring and caring eyes, they knew that he had made this decision a long time ago. He seemed to have never appreciated his two sons so much.
To be honest, Li Tianming felt that he had underestimated Li Yanfeng's shamelessness.
This man is truly amazing.
More importantly, when he looked at Liu Qianyang's handsome face that looked like a girl, he seemed to have a similar feeling.Three years ago, the monster 'Lin Xiaoting' in Lei Zun Mansion had many followers, some of whom were eleven or twelve years old. Although the person in front of him had grown up, Li Tianming could probably remember what he looked like three years ago.
That's right, Li Tianming met Liu Qianyang three years ago!
"Li Tianming, when brother Xiaoting executed your companion beast three years ago, I saw it at the scene."
After receiving the permission, Liu Qianyang jumped off the Tingfeng Tower in front of everyone, and his crystal clear eyes locked directly on Li Tianming.
Sure enough it was him!
At that desperate moment, Li Tianming remembered all the people in Lei Zun Mansion and all his enemies, including this child.
Of course, today he is no longer a child.
"The Yanhuang Token is now yours, but it's a pity because it is too difficult to get the Yanhuang Token in a competitive environment like Yandu, so I took a trick and entered the Yanhuang Academy as a Lihuo City."
Liu Qianyang landed on the listening platform and told the reason why he appeared here today.
